question: Sum of the angles made by a chord at the centre and on the major arc of a circle is 180 degree. What will be the angle made at the centre of the circle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of the angle at the **center** to the angle on the **major arc** (circumference) is always 2 : 1.

Total parts = 2 + 1 = 3 units.

Given 3 units = 180°

1 unit = 60°

Angle at the **center** = 2 units = 2 × 60° = 120°.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sum of the angles made by a chord at the center and on the major arc is 180°.

**Formula Used:** The angle subtended by an **arc** (or chord) at the **center** is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the **major arc** (remaining part of the circle).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ef1e5a46cb6c98c6616658934f993d12e63fbbd8ee4c66514b3ae4cd567424b.png] 

Let the angle made on the **major arc** be x.

According to the theorem, the angle at the **center** will be 2x.

⇒ 2x + x = 180°

⇒ 3x = 180°

⇒ x = 180° ÷ 3

⇒ x = 60°

Now, the angle at the **center** of the circle:

⇒ 2x = 2 × 60°

⇒ 2x = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle in a Semicircle

The angle subtended by a diameter at any point on the circumference is always 90°.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

The sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is always 180°.

Angles in the same segment

Angles subtended by the same arc at any point on the remaining part of the circle are equal.</p
